name: system.shutdown_blockers
description: List windows that have registered a shutdown block reason via `ShutdownBlockReasonCreate`. Useful before issuing system.shutdown / system.reboot.

hwnd.description: Window handle in `win:0x<hex>` form. Matches the convention used by window.list, window.focus, etc.

reason.description: Free-text reason supplied by the calling app to ShutdownBlockReasonCreate (capped at 100 chars by Win32).

blockers.description: Empty array if no windows have registered a block.

x-implementations.name: shutdown_block_reason_query
x-implementations.description: Enumerates top-level windows via EnumWindows + ShutdownBlockReasonQuery. Vista+ only.

windows-modern.description: Walks top-level windows with EnumWindows; for each, calls ShutdownBlockReasonQuery and includes the entry only if a reason is registered. Read-only; no side effects.

windows-classic.reason: Requires ShutdownBlockReasonCreate / ShutdownBlockReasonQuery (Vista+). NT 4 / 2000 / XP have no equivalent API for app-level shutdown blocks.
